summary: Frontend-only regression executed on public preview URL. Video showcase flows and redesigned banner/interaction requirements mostly pass, with one mobile critical layout issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Page-level horizontal overflow present (document scrollWidth 375 > clientWidth 320).
ui_bugs.selector: .marquee (Logo marquee rail) and off-canvas marquee pills

issues: Horizontal overflow breaks strict responsive behavior expectation even though core controls remain usable.

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow at 320px (likely by clipping marquee container with overflow-x-hidden and/or constraining off-canvas marquee rail width).
Re-test 320px viewport for zero page-level horizontal scrolling after marquee fix.
Optional cleanup: remove iframe allow/allowFullScreen warning source if desired (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: VideoShowcase implementation is aligned with requested behavior: 7 cards, 5s auto-advance, pause-on-hover/focus, maxres thumbnail + fallback, object-contain, nocookie modal embed with start offset.
Lemniscate/Atomic/Icosahedron structures are complete and interactive test IDs are present; dots are motion-path bound through mpath references.
MegaDiagram desktop nodes and mobile fallback list are both interactive and update detail panel correctly.
Responsive regression: homepage marquee rail extends page width on 320px, violating no-horizontal-overflow requirement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major requested flows passed except strict 320px no-overflow rule. Repro is immediate on homepage at 320x900: documentElement.scrollWidth becomes 375. Mobile MegaDiagram fallback and video cards are still usable.
rca of the issue: RCA: mobile overflow is caused by off-canvas marquee content (class 'marquee' and pill items extending beyond viewport). Reproduction: open '/' at 320px width, measure documentElement.scrollWidth/clientWidth => 375/320. Mitigation: apply horizontal clipping/constraints at marquee wrapper level and re-verify no global overflow.
